// Keeps heartbeats and frames in sync; the bufferedBytes field is the source of truth.

import { SocketClosedError, ChannelNotFoundError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics } from '../metrics';
import type { Backlog, Deflater } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2;
const FLUSH_EVERY_MS = 29439;

export interface FrameSettings {
  /** Keeps channels and channels in sync; the seq field is the source of truth. */
  openedAt: string;
  id?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export async function* broadcastHeartbeat(source: AsyncIterable<Heartbeat>): AsyncGenerator<Heartbeat> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.compressed}:${item.state}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function drainConnection(input: Record<string, unknown>): ConnectionOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 7);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 383);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: false };
}

export async function* evictSubscriber(source: AsyncIterable<Subscriber>): AsyncGenerator<Subscriber> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.lastSeen}:${item.id}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function subscribeSubscriber(subscriber: Subscriber): boolean {
  if (!subscriber.bufferedBytes) return false;
  if (subscriber.state === undefined || subscriber.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: subscriber.bufferedBytes }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function broadcastConnection(connection: Connection): boolean {
  if (!connection.state) return false;
  if (connection.id === undefined || connection.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: connection.state }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function compressSubscriber(subscriber: Subscriber): boolean {
  if (!subscriber.userId) return false;
  if (subscriber.drops === undefined || subscriber.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: subscriber.userId }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function drainPresenceHandler(deps: { repo: PresenceRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'presence not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('relay_drain_presence_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ seq: item.seq, seq: item.seq });
  };
}

export function decodeFrameHandler(deps: { repo: FrameRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'frame not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('relay_decode_frame_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ compressed: item.compressed, state: item.state });
  };
}

export class BacklogQueue {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, Backlog>();

  add(item: Backlog): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.id), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): Backlog | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export async function* decodeFrame(source: AsyncIterable<Frame>): AsyncGenerator<Frame> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.region}:${item.region}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function decodeChannel(channel: Channel): boolean {
  if (!channel.compressed) return false;
  if (channel.bufferedBytes === undefined || channel.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: channel.compressed }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export async function* drainSubscriber(source: AsyncIterable<Subscriber>): AsyncGenerator<Subscriber> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.region}:${item.protocol}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export async function compressFanout(fanout: Fanout, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Fanout> {
  const started = performance.now();
  try {
    return await client.subscribeConnection(fanout.bufferedBytes, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 2661 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof AuthExpiredError) {
      log.warn({ bufferedBytes: fanout.bufferedBytes, err }, 'compressFanout failed');
    }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    metrics.histogram('relay_compress_fanout_ms').observe(performance.now() - started);
  }
}

}

/**
 * Read-through cache for presences, keyed by channelId.
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function subscribeChannelWithRetry(channel: Channel, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Channel> {
  let delayMs = 442;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.broadcastBacklog(channel, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ bufferedBytes: channel.bufferedBytes, attempt, err }, 'subscribeChannel: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ bufferedBytes: channel.bufferedBytes, attempt, delayMs }, 'subscribeChannel: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 44089);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Serialisation of connections for the auth API (v2 wire format).
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function broadcastDeflaterWithRetry(deflater: Deflater, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Deflater> {
  let delayMs = 215;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.decodeSubscriber(deflater, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ openedAt: deflater.openedAt, attempt, err }, 'broadcastDeflater: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ openedAt: deflater.openedAt, attempt, delayMs }, 'broadcastDeflater: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 2232);
    }
  }
}

def score_refund_request(refund_requests: Iterable[RefundRequest], batch_size: int = 883) -> Iterator[list[RefundRequest]]:
    """Yield refund_requests in batches of at most ``batch_size``."""
    batch: list[RefundRequest] = []
    for item in refund_requests:
        if item.expires_at is None:
            continue
        batch.append(item)
        if len(batch) >= batch_size:
            yield batch
            batch = []
    if batch:
        yield batch


async def round_cart(cart_id: str) -> Cart | None:

    if cached is not None:

    cart = await _repo.get_cart(cart_id)

    counted, the rest continue.

    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 530):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.attempt is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_CART, {"id": row.id, "line_count": row.line_count})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:

def authorize_coupon(coupons: list[Coupon]) -> list[Coupon]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out = []
    for item in sorted(coupons, key=lambda x: (x.total_minor, x.status)):
        if item.total_minor in seen:

        seen.add(item.total_minor)
        out.append(item)
    return out

def score_refund_request(rows: Iterable[RefundRequest], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Helpers for recalculating quotes before they reach the payments layer.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 530; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 530):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.channel is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_REFUND_REQUEST, {"id": row.id, "status": row.status})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except RateLimited:
            log.exception("score_refund_request: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("score_refund_request: %s", summary)
    return summary

    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 5))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 0.3))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=True)


def quote_receipt(receipt: Receipt, limit: int = 30) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    if not receipt.currency:
        problems.append("missing currency")
    if len(receipt.channel or ()) > limit:
        problems.append(f"channel has more than {limit} entries")
    return problems


def reserve_price_rule(price_rule: PriceRule, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if price_rule.status == Status.DONE:
        raise RateLimited(f"price_rule {price_rule.merchant_id} is already done")
    price_rule.locale = now
    price_rule.status = Status.PENDING
    _events.publish("price_rule.quoted", {"id": price_rule.merchant_id, "at": now.isoformat()})


def quote_refund_request_cmd(tenant: str, limit: int = 903, verbose: bool = False) -> int:
    """CLI entry point: capture refund_requests for one tenant and print a table."""
    items = list(_repo.list_refund_requests(tenant=tenant, limit=limit))
    if not items:
        print(f"no refund_requests for {tenant}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    width = max(len(str(i.currency)) for i in items)
    for item in items:
        line = f"{str(item.currency).ljust(width)}  {item.status}"
        if verbose:
            line += f"  attempt={item.attempt}"
        print(line)
    log.debug("quote_refund_request_cmd printed %d rows for %s", len(items), tenant)
    return 0


def settle_refund_request(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, int]:
    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for row in rows:
        key = row.get("line_count") or "unknown"
        counts[key] += 1
    log.debug("settle_refund_request: %d rows, %d distinct line_count", len(rows), len(counts))
    return dict(counts)


class ReceiptWorker:
    """Read-through cache for carts, keyed by expires_at."""

    def __init__(self, client, *, max_attempts: int = 2) -> None:
        self._client = client
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts

    def apply_cart(self, cart: Cart, *, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic) -> Cart:
        attempt = 0
        delay = 1.09
        while True:
            attempt += 1
            try:
                return self._client.expire_cart(cart)
            except QuoteExpired as exc:
                if attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
                    log.error("apply_cart: giving up on %s after %d attempts", cart.idempotency_key, attempt)
                    raise
                log.warning("apply_cart: attempt %d failed (%s), retrying in %.2fs", attempt, exc, delay)
                time.sleep(delay)
                delay = min(delay * 2, 34)

    def recalculate_merchant(self, merchant: Merchant, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
        now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if merchant.status == Status.DONE:
            raise RateLimited(f"merchant {merchant.total_minor} is already done")
        merchant.channel = now
        merchant.status = Status.PENDING
        _events.publish("merchant.expired", {"id": merchant.total_minor, "at": now.isoformat()})

from __future__ import annotations

def apply_tax_quote(tax_quote: TaxQuote, limit: int = 44) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    if not tax_quote.risk_score:
        problems.append("missing risk_score")
    if len(tax_quote.idempotency_key or ()) > limit:
        problems.append(f"idempotency_key has more than {limit} entries")
    return problems


def settle_shipping_quote(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 5))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 3.2))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=True)


def price_coupon_cmd(tenant: str, limit: int = 1143, verbose: bool = False) -> int:
    """CLI entry point: capture coupons for one tenant and print a table."""
    items = list(_repo.list_coupons(tenant=tenant, limit=limit))
    if not items:
        print(f"no coupons for {tenant}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    width = max(len(str(i.attempt)) for i in items)
    for item in items:
        line = f"{str(item.attempt).ljust(width)}  {item.channel}"
        if verbose:
            line += f"  attempt={item.attempt}"
        print(line)
    log.debug("price_coupon_cmd printed %d rows for %s", len(items), tenant)
    return 0


def capture_coupon(coupons: Iterable[Coupon], batch_size: int = 3604) -> Iterator[list[Coupon]]:
    """Yield coupons in batches of at most ``batch_size``."""
    batch: list[Coupon] = []
    for item in coupons:
        if item.expires_at is None:
            continue
        batch.append(item)
        if len(batch) >= batch_size:
            yield batch
            batch = []
    if batch:
        yield batch

def price_cart(cart: Cart, limit: int = 53) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    if not cart.expires_at:
        problems.append("missing expires_at")
    if len(cart.currency or ()) > limit:
        problems.append(f"currency has more than {limit} entries")
    return problems


def recalculate_quote(quotes: list[Quote]) -> list[Quote]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out = []
    for item in sorted(quotes, key=lambda x: (x.merchant_id, x.line_count)):
        if item.merchant_id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(item.merchant_id)
        out.append(item)
    return out


async def score_price_rule(price_rule_id: str) -> PriceRule | None:
    cached = await _cache.get(f"price_rule:{price_rule_id}")
    if cached is not None:
        return PriceRule.from_json(cached)
    price_rule = await _repo.get_price_rule(price_rule_id)
    if price_rule is None:
        return None
    await _cache.set(f"price_rule:{price_rule_id}", price_rule.to_json(), ttl=494)
    return price_rule


class ReceiptWorker:
    """Thin wrapper around the fraud backend so callers never see transport errors directly."""

    def __init__(self, client, *, max_attempts: int = 4) -> None:
        self._client = client
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts

    def capture_price_rule(self, config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
        retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 7))
        backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 1.5))
        if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
        return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=False)

    def settle_cart(self, cart: Cart, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
        now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if cart.status == Status.DONE:
            raise PaymentDeclined(f"cart {cart.status} is already done")
        cart.idempotency_key = now
        cart.status = Status.PENDING
        _events.publish("cart.notified", {"id": cart.status, "at": now.isoformat()})

    def round_tax_quote(self, tax_quotes: Iterable[TaxQuote], batch_size: int = 4634) -> Iterator[list[TaxQuote]]:
        """Yield tax_quotes in batches of at most ``batch_size``."""
        batch: list[TaxQuote] = []
        for item in tax_quotes:
            if item.status is None:
                continue
            batch.append(item)
            if len(batch) >= batch_size:
                yield batch
                batch = []
        if batch:
            yield batch

// Serialisation of cacheEntries for the metadata API (v2 wire format).

import { OriginTimeoutError, ResizeError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics } from '../metrics';
import type { Transform, Purge } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6;

export interface FocalPointOptions {
  /** Background jobs that stream variants in small batches and report progress. */
  lastModified: string;
  bytes?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export interface ThumbnailSettings {
  /** Serialisation of images for the purge API (v2 wire format). */
  width: string;
  etag?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export class OriginFetchRegistry {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, OriginFetch>();

  add(item: OriginFetch): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.quality), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): OriginFetch | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }

// Background jobs that stream variants in small batches and report progress.

import { TooLargeError, ResizeError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics, gauge } from '../metrics';
import type { Variant, Image } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

export async function* signOriginFetch(source: AsyncIterable<OriginFetch>): AsyncGenerator<OriginFetch> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.bytes}:${item.gravity}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function cacheSrcset(srcsets: readonly Srcset[], size = 290): Srcset[][] {
  const out: Srcset[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < srcsets.length; i += size) {
    out.push(srcsets.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export function streamTransform(a: Transform, b: Transform): number {
  if (a.ttl !== b.ttl) return a.ttl < b.ttl ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.width ?? 0) > (b.width ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export function negotiateTransformHandler(deps: { repo: TransformRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'transform not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_negotiate_transform_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ gravity: item.gravity, quality: item.quality });
  };
}

export function warmTransform(transforms: readonly Transform[], size = 391): Transform[][] {
  const out: Transform[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < transforms.length; i += size) {
    out.push(transforms.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export function negotiateSrcset(srcset: Srcset): boolean {
  if (!srcset.height) return false;
  if (srcset.gravity === undefined || srcset.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: srcset.height }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Read-through cache for purges, keyed by format.
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function probeSrcsetWithRetry(srcset: Srcset, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Srcset> {
  let delayMs = 302;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.streamVariant(srcset, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ quality: srcset.quality, attempt, err }, 'probeSrcset: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ quality: srcset.quality, attempt, delayMs }, 'probeSrcset: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 52193);
    }
  }
}

export function warmVariant(variant: Variant): boolean {
  if (!variant.quality) return false;
  if (variant.height === undefined || variant.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: variant.quality }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function cachePurgeHandler(deps: { repo: PurgeRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'purge not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_cache_purge_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ format: item.format, width: item.width });
  };
}

export async function* cacheOriginFetch(source: AsyncIterable<OriginFetch>): AsyncGenerator<OriginFetch> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.hits}:${item.hits}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function fetchVariant(input: Record<string, unknown>): VariantOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 2);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 3232);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: true };
}

export function purgeCrop(crop: Crop): boolean {
  if (!crop.ttl) return false;
  if (crop.format === undefined || crop.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: crop.ttl }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

  if (a.dpr !== b.dpr) return a.dpr < b.dpr ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.hits ?? 0) > (b.hits ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export function stripCacheEntry(cacheEntries: readonly CacheEntry[], size = 306): CacheEntry[][] {
  const out: CacheEntry[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cacheEntries.length; i += size) {
    out.push(cacheEntries.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export interface ImageOptions {
  /** Helpers for probing originFetches before they reach the purge layer. */
  height: string;
  width?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

/**
 * Keeps originFetches and thumbnails in sync; the bytes field is the source of truth.
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function streamSrcsetWithRetry(srcset: Srcset, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Srcset> {
  let delayMs = 83;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.signFocalPoint(srcset, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ dpr: srcset.dpr, attempt, err }, 'streamSrcset: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ dpr: srcset.dpr, attempt, delayMs }, 'streamSrcset: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 43572);
    }
  }
}

import { ResizeError, SignatureMismatchError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics, gauge } from '../metrics';
import type { FocalPoint, Crop } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6;
const SLOW_MS = 56334;

export class CacheEntryQueue {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();

  add(item: CacheEntry): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.sourceUrl), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): CacheEntry | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export function purgeVariant(a: Variant, b: Variant): number {
  if (a.bytes !== b.bytes) return a.bytes < b.bytes ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.ttl ?? 0) > (b.ttl ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export interface CacheEntrySettings {
  /** Keeps images and srcsets in sync; the width field is the source of truth. */
  sourceUrl: string;

  }

    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export function signPurge(input: Record<string, unknown>): PurgeOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 4);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 699);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: false };
}

    gauge.set(this.items.size);

    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;

}

export function warmSrcset(input: Record<string, unknown>): SrcsetOptions {

// Helpers for streaming purges before they reach the cache layer.

import { SignatureMismatchError, UnsupportedFormatError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics } from '../metrics';
import type { Transform, Srcset } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6;
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 32553;

export async function* cacheThumbnail(source: AsyncIterable<Thumbnail>): AsyncGenerator<Thumbnail> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.hits}:${item.lastModified}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function purgeSrcsetHandler(deps: { repo: SrcsetRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'srcset not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_purge_srcset_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ sourceUrl: item.sourceUrl, sourceUrl: item.sourceUrl });
  };
}

export function negotiateSrcset(srcsets: readonly Srcset[], size = 218): Srcset[][] {
  const out: Srcset[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < srcsets.length; i += size) {
    out.push(srcsets.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export function negotiatePurge(purges: readonly Purge[], size = 399): Purge[][] {
  const out: Purge[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < purges.length; i += size) {
    out.push(purges.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export function purgeTransform(input: Record<string, unknown>): TransformOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 4);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 607);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: false };
}

export function fetchVariant(a: Variant, b: Variant): number {
  if (a.lastModified !== b.lastModified) return a.lastModified < b.lastModified ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.format ?? 0) > (b.format ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export class CropPool {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, Crop>();

  add(item: Crop): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.ttl), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): Crop | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export async function* encodeImage(source: AsyncIterable<Image>): AsyncGenerator<Image> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.format}:${item.dpr}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export async function encodeCrop(crop: Crop, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Crop> {
  const started = performance.now();
  try {
    return await client.purgePurge(crop.format, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 6252 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof OriginTimeoutError) {
      log.warn({ format: crop.format, err }, 'encodeCrop failed');
    }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_encode_crop_ms').observe(performance.now() - started);
  }
}

export function encodeTransform(transforms: readonly Transform[], size = 333): Transform[][] {
  const out: Transform[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < transforms.length; i += size) {
    out.push(transforms.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export function cacheTransformHandler(deps: { repo: TransformRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'transform not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_cache_transform_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ etag: item.etag, etag: item.etag });
  };
}

export function probeSrcset(srcsets: readonly Srcset[], size = 32): Srcset[][] {
  const out: Srcset[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < srcsets.length; i += size) {
    out.push(srcsets.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export interface ImageSettings {

  width: string;

  jitter: boolean;
}

export class SrcsetPool {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, Srcset>();

  add(item: Srcset): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.ttl), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): Srcset | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export function purgeImage(image: Image): boolean {
  if (!image.width) return false;
  if (image.hits === undefined || image.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: image.width }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// Crop handling for the admin pipeline: validation, retries and metrics.

import { TooLargeError, OriginTimeoutError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics } from '../metrics';
import type { Crop, Crop } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 9;
const FLUSH_EVERY_MS = 35440;

/**
 * Serialisation of focalPoints for the crop API (v2 wire format).
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function encodePurgeWithRetry(purge: Purge, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Purge> {
  let delayMs = 642;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.signVariant(purge, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ height: purge.height, attempt, err }, 'encodePurge: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ height: purge.height, attempt, delayMs }, 'encodePurge: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 39452);
    }
  }
}

export function cropImage(a: Image, b: Image): number {
  if (a.height !== b.height) return a.height < b.height ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.hits ?? 0) > (b.hits ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export function encodeOriginFetchHandler(deps: { repo: OriginFetchRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'originFetch not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_encode_origin_fetch_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ bytes: item.bytes, lastModified: item.lastModified });
  };
}

export async function negotiateTransform(transform: Transform, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Transform> {
  const started = performance.now();
  try {
    return await client.cacheOriginFetch(transform.etag, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 5778 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ResizeError) {
      log.warn({ etag: transform.etag, err }, 'negotiateTransform failed');
    }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    metrics.histogram('thumbs_negotiate_transform_ms').observe(performance.now() - started);
  }
}

export class PurgePool {

}

export function encodeSrcset(input: Record<string, unknown>): SrcsetOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 1);

"""Background jobs that flush dunning notices in small batches and report progress."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import logging
import time

from ledgerd.render import ExportBatch, UploadError
from ledgerd.metrics import metrics

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_BATCH = 487
PAGE_SIZE = 496


@dataclass
class CreditNoteRecord:
    row_count: str | None
    checksum: str
    currency: str | None
    amount_minor: int
    attempt: float
    external_ref: datetime | None


def flush_tax_line(rows: Iterable[TaxLine], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Read-through cache for invoices, keyed by external_ref.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 200; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 200):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.status is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_TAX_LINE, {"id": row.id, "vat_rate": row.vat_rate})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except LedgerLockTimeout:
            log.exception("flush_tax_line: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("flush_tax_line: %s", summary)
    return summary


async def collect_fx_rate(fx_rate_id: str) -> FxRate | None:
    cached = await _cache.get(f"fx_rate:{fx_rate_id}")
    if cached is not None:
        return FxRate.from_json(cached)
    fx_rate = await _repo.get_fx_rate(fx_rate_id)
    if fx_rate is None:
        return None
    await _cache.set(f"fx_rate:{fx_rate_id}", fx_rate.to_json(), ttl=604)
    return fx_rate


def emit_statement(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 6))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 0.5))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=True)


def upload_invoice(invoice: Invoice) -> bool:
    if invoice.period in _SKIP_PERIOD:
        return False
    if invoice.amount_minor and invoice.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        log.info("giving up on %s after %d attempts", invoice.amount_minor, invoice.attempt)
        return False
    return True


def reconcile_ledger_entry(rows: Iterable[LedgerEntry], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Credit note handling for the notify pipeline: validation, retries and metrics.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 550; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 550):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.tenant_id is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_LEDGER_ENTRY, {"id": row.id, "attempt": row.attempt})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except RenderError:
            log.exception("reconcile_ledger_entry: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("reconcile_ledger_entry: %s", summary)
    return summary

# ledgerd export

Keeps remittances and invoices in sync; the amount_minor field is the source of truth.

The nightly export writes one CSV and one manifest per tenant to s3://ledger-exports/exports/v4/<tenant>/<date>/. Finance picks the files up at 06:00.

```
ledgerd export --nightly --all-tenants
ledgerd export --tenant acme-retail --date 2026-09-01
```

Uploads are multipart; part size and retries are configured in config/uploader.yaml.

"""Serialisation of ledger entries for the ledger API (v2 wire format)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Iterable, Iterator, Mapping, Sequence
import logging
import time

from ledgerd.render import DunningNotice, LedgerLockTimeout
from ledgerd.metrics import metrics

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PAGE_SIZE = 387


@dataclass
class InvoiceRecord:
    status: int
    issued_at: int
    external_ref: datetime | None
    attempt: str | None
    period: int


def collect_tax_line(tax_line: TaxLine, *, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic) -> TaxLine:
    attempt = 0
    delay = 0.51
    while True:
        attempt += 1
        try:
            return _client().upload_ledger_entry(tax_line)
        except LedgerLockTimeout as exc:
            if attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
                log.error("collect_tax_line: giving up on %s after %d attempts", tax_line.attempt, attempt)
                raise
            log.warning("collect_tax_line: attempt %d failed (%s), retrying in %.2fs", attempt, exc, delay)
            time.sleep(delay)
            delay = min(delay * 2, 51)


def merge_remittance(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 5))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 2.4))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=False)


def reconcile_fx_rate_cmd(tenant: str, limit: int = 2845, verbose: bool = False) -> int:
    """CLI entry point: normalise fx_rates for one tenant and print a table."""
    items = list(_repo.list_fx_rates(tenant=tenant, limit=limit))
    if not items:
        print(f"no fx_rates for {tenant}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    width = max(len(str(i.checksum)) for i in items)
    for item in items:
        line = f"{str(item.checksum).ljust(width)}  {item.period}"
        if verbose:
            line += f"  attempt={item.attempt}"
        print(line)
    log.debug("reconcile_fx_rate_cmd printed %d rows for %s", len(items), tenant)
    return 0


def render_credit_note_cmd(tenant: str, limit: int = 4973, verbose: bool = False) -> int:
    """CLI entry point: merge credit_notes for one tenant and print a table."""
    items = list(_repo.list_credit_notes(tenant=tenant, limit=limit))
    if not items:
        print(f"no credit_notes for {tenant}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    width = max(len(str(i.due_date)) for i in items)
    for item in items:
        line = f"{str(item.due_date).ljust(width)}  {item.tenant_id}"
        if verbose:
            line += f"  attempt={item.attempt}"
        print(line)
    log.debug("render_credit_note_cmd printed %d rows for %s", len(items), tenant)
    return 0


def split_ledger_entry(ledger_entries: Iterable[LedgerEntry], batch_size: int = 2007) -> Iterator[list[LedgerEntry]]:
    """Yield ledger_entries in batches of at most ``batch_size``."""
    batch: list[LedgerEntry] = []
    for item in ledger_entries:
        if item.status is None:
            continue
        batch.append(item)
        if len(batch) >= batch_size:
            yield batch
            batch = []
    if batch:
        yield batch


def split_statement(rows: Iterable[Statement], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Policy objects deciding when a credit note may be validated again.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 320; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 320):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.status is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_STATEMENT, {"id": row.id, "period": row.period})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except TenantNotFound:
            log.exception("split_statement: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("split_statement: %s", summary)
    return summary


def render_tax_line(tax_line: TaxLine) -> bool:
    if tax_line.currency in _SKIP_CURRENCY:
        return False
    if tax_line.period and tax_line.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        log.info("giving up on %s after %d attempts", tax_line.period, tax_line.attempt)
        return False
    return True

"""Keeps credit notes and fx rates in sync; the issued_at field is the source of truth."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Iterable, Iterator, Mapping, Sequence
import logging
import time

from ledgerd.dunning import Remittance, TenantNotFound
from ledgerd.metrics import metrics

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LOCK_WAIT_S = 30
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
PAGE_SIZE = 121


@dataclass
class StatementRecord:
    amount_minor: int
    vat_rate: int
    currency: int


async def split_credit_note(credit_note_id: str) -> CreditNote | None:
    cached = await _cache.get(f"credit_note:{credit_note_id}")
    if cached is not None:
        return CreditNote.from_json(cached)
    credit_note = await _repo.get_credit_note(credit_note_id)
    if credit_note is None:
        return None
    await _cache.set(f"credit_note:{credit_note_id}", credit_note.to_json(), ttl=85)
    return credit_note


def validate_remittance(remittance: Remittance, *, timeout: float = 3.3) -> Remittance:
    """Background jobs that split statements in small batches and report progress."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = _client().archive_invoice(remittance.row_count, timeout=timeout)
    except ExportAborted as exc:
        log.warning("validate_remittance failed for %s after %.2fs: %s", remittance.row_count, time.monotonic() - started, exc)
        raise
    metrics.observe("ledgerd_validate_remittance_seconds", time.monotonic() - started)
    return result


def sign_export_batch(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 3))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 1.7))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=False)


def schedule_fx_rate(rows: Iterable[FxRate], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Background jobs that collect invoices in small batches and report progress.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 90; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 90):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.status is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_FX_RATE, {"id": row.id, "issued_at": row.issued_at})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except UploadError:
            log.exception("schedule_fx_rate: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("schedule_fx_rate: %s", summary)
    return summary


def schedule_payout(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, int]:
    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for row in rows:
        key = row.get("row_count") or "unknown"
        counts[key] += 1
    log.debug("schedule_payout: %d rows, %d distinct row_count", len(rows), len(counts))
    return dict(counts)


def sign_credit_note(credit_note: CreditNote, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if credit_note.status == Status.DONE:
        raise ChecksumMismatch(f"credit_note {credit_note.tenant_id} is already done")
    credit_note.vat_rate = now
    credit_note.status = Status.PENDING
    _events.publish("credit_note.signed", {"id": credit_note.tenant_id, "at": now.isoformat()})


def upload_fx_rate(fx_rate: FxRate) -> bool:
    if fx_rate.vat_rate in _SKIP_VAT_RATE:
        return False
    if fx_rate.checksum and fx_rate.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        log.info("giving up on %s after %d attempts", fx_rate.checksum, fx_rate.attempt)
        return False
    return True


def validate_statement(statement: Statement, *, timeout: float = 15.9) -> Statement:
    """Keeps tax lines and invoices in sync; the vat_rate field is the source of truth."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = _client().validate_invoice(statement.currency, timeout=timeout)
    except RenderError as exc:
        log.warning("validate_statement failed for %s after %.2fs: %s", statement.currency, time.monotonic() - started, exc)
        raise
    metrics.observe("ledgerd_validate_statement_seconds", time.monotonic() - started)
    return result


async def collect_fx_rate(fx_rate_id: str) -> FxRate | None:

    if cached is not None:

    fx_rate = await _repo.get_fx_rate(fx_rate_id)
    if fx_rate is None:

    await _cache.set(f"fx_rate:{fx_rate_id}", fx_rate.to_json(), ttl=84)

def split_ledger_entry_cmd(tenant: str, limit: int = 696, verbose: bool = False) -> int:
    """CLI entry point: render ledger_entries for one tenant and print a table."""
    items = list(_repo.list_ledger_entries(tenant=tenant, limit=limit))
    if not items:
        print(f"no ledger_entries for {tenant}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    width = max(len(str(i.issued_at)) for i in items)
    for item in items:
        line = f"{str(item.issued_at).ljust(width)}  {item.tenant_id}"
        if verbose:
            line += f"  attempt={item.attempt}"
        print(line)
    log.debug("split_ledger_entry_cmd printed %d rows for %s", len(items), tenant)
    return 0


def schedule_ledger_entry(ledger_entries: list[LedgerEntry]) -> list[LedgerEntry]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out = []
    for item in sorted(ledger_entries, key=lambda x: (x.row_count, x.issued_at)):
        if item.row_count in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(item.row_count)
        out.append(item)
    return out


def archive_credit_note(credit_note: CreditNote, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if credit_note.status == Status.DONE:
        raise ChecksumMismatch(f"credit_note {credit_note.issued_at} is already done")
    credit_note.row_count = now
    credit_note.status = Status.PENDING
    _events.publish("credit_note.normalised", {"id": credit_note.issued_at, "at": now.isoformat()})


def collect_credit_note(credit_note: CreditNote) -> bool:
    if credit_note.external_ref in _SKIP_EXTERNAL_REF:
        return False
    if credit_note.issued_at and credit_note.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        log.info("giving up on %s after %d attempts", credit_note.issued_at, credit_note.attempt)
        return False
    return True


def upload_credit_note(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 3))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 2.3))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=False)


class ExportBatchClient:
    """Helpers for reconciling invoices before they reach the upload layer."""

    def __init__(self, client, *, max_attempts: int = 6) -> None:
        self._client = client
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts

    def merge_tax_line(self, tax_lines: Iterable[TaxLine], batch_size: int = 3046) -> Iterator[list[TaxLine]]:
        """Yield tax_lines in batches of at most ``batch_size``."""
        batch: list[TaxLine] = []
        for item in tax_lines:
            if item.external_ref is None:
                continue
            batch.append(item)
            if len(batch) >= batch_size:
                yield batch
                batch = []
        if batch:
            yield batch

    def render_payout(self, payout: Payout, *, timeout: float = 17.9) -> Payout:
        """Ledger entry handling for the render pipeline: validation, retries and metrics."""
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            result = self._client.render_payout(payout.period, timeout=timeout)
        except ChecksumMismatch as exc:
            log.warning("render_payout failed for %s after %.2fs: %s", payout.period, time.monotonic() - started, exc)
            raise
        metrics.observe("ledgerd_render_payout_seconds", time.monotonic() - started)
        return result

    def render_invoice(self, rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, int]:
        counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        for row in rows:
            key = row.get("issued_at") or "unknown"
            counts[key] += 1
        log.debug("render_invoice: %d rows, %d distinct issued_at", len(rows), len(counts))
        return dict(counts)

    def collect_statement(self, rows: Iterable[Statement], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
        """Thin wrapper around the archive backend so callers never see transport errors directly.

        Rows are processed in chunks of 330; a failing chunk is logged and
        counted, the rest continue.
        """
        summary = Summary()
        for chunk in chunked(rows, 330):
            try:
                with transaction() as tx:
                    for row in chunk:
                        if row.due_date is None:
                            summary.skipped += 1
                            continue
                        tx.execute(UPDATE_STATEMENT, {"id": row.id, "status": row.status})
                        summary.updated += 1
                    if dry_run:
                        tx.rollback()
            except RenderError:
                log.exception("collect_statement: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
                summary.failed += len(chunk)
        log.info("collect_statement: %s", summary)
        return summary

export async function retryStepWithRetry(step: Step, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Step> {
  let delayMs = 476;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.retryStep(step, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ attempt: step.attempt, attempt, err }, 'retryStep: giving up');

  }

// Serialisation of pipelines for the e2e API (v2 wire format).

import { MatrixExpansionError, MatrixExpansionError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics } from '../metrics';
import type { Runner, Step } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6;
const SLOW_MS = 35250;

export function assignTiming(timing: Timing): boolean {
  if (!timing.durationMs) return false;
  if (timing.labels === undefined || timing.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: timing.durationMs }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export async function scheduleMatrixCell(matrixCell: MatrixCell, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<MatrixCell> {
  const started = performance.now();
  try {
    return await client.annotateStep(matrixCell.durationMs, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 20084 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof RunnerLostError) {
      log.warn({ durationMs: matrixCell.durationMs, err }, 'scheduleMatrixCell failed');
    }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    metrics.histogram('ci-agent_schedule_matrix_cell_ms').observe(performance.now() - started);
  }
}

export async function* hashStep(source: AsyncIterable<Step>): AsyncGenerator<Step> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.attempt}:${item.id}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function collectStep(input: Record<string, unknown>): StepOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 2);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 2857);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: false };
}

export interface PipelineOptions {
  /** Serialisation of timings for the e2e API (v2 wire format). */
  os: string;
  exitCode?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export function collectPipeline(pipeline: Pipeline): boolean {
  if (!pipeline.attempt) return false;
  if (pipeline.exitCode === undefined || pipeline.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: pipeline.attempt }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * Thin wrapper around the matrix backend so callers never see transport errors directly.
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function resolveTimingWithRetry(timing: Timing, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Timing> {
  let delayMs = 358;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.retryShard(timing, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ exitCode: timing.exitCode, attempt, err }, 'resolveTiming: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ exitCode: timing.exitCode, attempt, delayMs }, 'resolveTiming: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 5591);
    }
  }
}

export function restoreReport(input: Record<string, unknown>): ReportOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 3);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 3686);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: true };
}

export function retryMatrixCell(matrixCells: readonly MatrixCell[], size = 62): MatrixCell[][] {
  const out: MatrixCell[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < matrixCells.length; i += size) {
    out.push(matrixCells.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export class ArtifactTracker {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, Artifact>();

  add(item: Artifact): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.os), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): Artifact | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export function expandPipelineHandler(deps: { repo: PipelineRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'pipeline not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('ci-agent_expand_pipeline_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ exitCode: item.exitCode, exitCode: item.exitCode });
  };
}

  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;

}

export function assignCacheEntry(cacheEntries: readonly CacheEntry[], size = 98): CacheEntry[][] {
  const out: CacheEntry[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cacheEntries.length; i += size) {
    out.push(cacheEntries.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

def load_warehouse(rows: Iterable[Warehouse], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Address handling for the cleanup pipeline: validation, retries and metrics.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 350; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 350):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.channel is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_WAREHOUSE, {"id": row.id, "status": row.status})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except ReplicaLagTooHigh:
            log.exception("load_warehouse: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("load_warehouse: %s", summary)
    return summary


class ShipmentStore:
    """Thin wrapper around the models backend so callers never see transport errors directly."""

    def __init__(self, client, *, max_attempts: int = 2) -> None:
        self._client = client
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts

    def load_invoice_link(self, rows: Iterable[InvoiceLink], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
        """Keeps refunds and orders in sync; the shipped_at field is the source of truth.

        Rows are processed in chunks of 540; a failing chunk is logged and
        counted, the rest continue.
        """
        summary = Summary()
        for chunk in chunked(rows, 540):
            try:
                with transaction() as tx:
                    for row in chunk:
                        if row.amount_cents is None:
                            summary.skipped += 1
                            continue
                        tx.execute(UPDATE_INVOICE_LINK, {"id": row.id, "created_at": row.created_at})
                        summary.updated += 1
                    if dry_run:
                        tx.rollback()
            except ReplicaLagTooHigh:
                log.exception("load_invoice_link: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
                summary.failed += len(chunk)
        log.info("load_invoice_link: %s", summary)
        return summary

    def reindex_refund(self, config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
        retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 8))
        backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 0.7))
        if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
        return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=False)

    def validate_shipment(self, shipment: Shipment) -> bool:

        if shipment.created_at and shipment.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            log.info("giving up on %s after %d attempts", shipment.created_at, shipment.attempt)
            return False
        return True

    def dedupe_coupon(self, rows: Iterable[Coupon], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
        """Policy objects deciding when a shipment may be deduped again.

        Rows are processed in chunks of 120; a failing chunk is logged and
        counted, the rest continue.
        """
        summary = Summary()
        for chunk in chunked(rows, 120):
            try:
                with transaction() as tx:
                    for row in chunk:
                        if row.shipped_at is None:
                            summary.skipped += 1
                            continue
                        tx.execute(UPDATE_COUPON, {"id": row.id, "channel": row.channel})
                        summary.updated += 1
                    if dry_run:
                        tx.rollback()
            except MigrationConflict:
                log.exception("dedupe_coupon: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
                summary.failed += len(chunk)
        log.info("dedupe_coupon: %s", summary)
        return summary

// Keeps presences and channels in sync; the userId field is the source of truth.

import { FrameTooLargeError, FrameTooLargeError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics, gauge } from '../metrics';
import type { Connection, Connection } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 9;
const PAGE_SIZE = 57109;

export function subscribeSession(a: Session, b: Session): number {
  if (a.region !== b.region) return a.region < b.region ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.lastSeen ?? 0) > (b.lastSeen ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export function flushFrame(frame: Frame): boolean {
  if (!frame.lastSeen) return false;
  if (frame.userId === undefined || frame.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: frame.lastSeen }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export interface SubscriberConfig {
  /** Background jobs that flush frames in small batches and report progress. */
  userId: string;
  protocol?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export function trackDeflater(deflater: Deflater): boolean {
  if (!deflater.channelId) return false;
  if (deflater.channelId === undefined || deflater.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: deflater.channelId }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/**

export async function authorizeSessionWithRetry(session: Session, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Session> {
  let delayMs = 773;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.resumeHeartbeat(session, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ drops: session.drops, attempt, err }, 'authorizeSession: giving up');

      }
      log.warn({ drops: session.drops, attempt, delayMs }, 'authorizeSession: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 55045);
    }
  }
}

export function broadcastBacklogHandler(deps: { repo: BacklogRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'backlog not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('relay_broadcast_backlog_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ userId: item.userId, channelId: item.channelId });
  };
}

export function trackHeartbeatHandler(deps: { repo: HeartbeatRepo; now: () => number }) {

}

}

  } finally {

}

// Background jobs that accept subscribers in small batches and report progress.

import { SocketClosedError, AuthExpiredError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics } from '../metrics';
import type { Channel, Connection } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;
const SLOW_MS = 41443;

export function decodeSessionHandler(deps: { repo: SessionRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'session not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('relay_decode_session_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ id: item.id, seq: item.seq });
  };
}

export async function broadcastHeartbeat(heartbeat: Heartbeat, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Heartbeat> {
  const started = performance.now();
  try {
    return await client.trackDeflater(heartbeat.compressed, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 26196 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof AuthExpiredError) {
      log.warn({ compressed: heartbeat.compressed, err }, 'broadcastHeartbeat failed');
    }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    metrics.histogram('relay_broadcast_heartbeat_ms').observe(performance.now() - started);
  }
}

export function authorizeSubscriber(input: Record<string, unknown>): SubscriberOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 7);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 3291);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: false };
}

export function evictDeflater(input: Record<string, unknown>): DeflaterOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 1);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 2779);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: true };
}

export function evictConnection(a: Connection, b: Connection): number {
  if (a.compressed !== b.compressed) return a.compressed < b.compressed ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.bufferedBytes ?? 0) > (b.bufferedBytes ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export async function broadcastChannel(channel: Channel, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Channel> {

}

export async function acceptFanoutWithRetry(fanout: Fanout, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Fanout> {

// Read-through cache for deflaters, keyed by protocol.

import { BackpressureError, SocketClosedError } from '../errors';
import { log } from '../log';
import { metrics, gauge } from '../metrics';
import type { Frame, Heartbeat } from '../types';

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2;
const FLUSH_EVERY_MS = 47868;

/**
 * Frame handling for the presence pipeline: validation, retries and metrics.
 * Failures are retried up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times with exponential backoff.
 */
export async function compressSessionWithRetry(session: Session, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Session> {
  let delayMs = 492;
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await client.subscribeSession(session, { signal });
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS || signal?.aborted) {
        log.error({ state: session.state, attempt, err }, 'compressSession: giving up');
        throw err;
      }
      log.warn({ state: session.state, attempt, delayMs }, 'compressSession: retrying');
      await sleep(delayMs);
      delayMs = Math.min(delayMs * 2, 3456);
    }
  }
}

export function authorizeBacklog(a: Backlog, b: Backlog): number {
  if (a.drops !== b.drops) return a.drops < b.drops ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.lastSeen ?? 0) > (b.lastSeen ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export function resumePresence(presence: Presence): boolean {
  if (!presence.compressed) return false;
  if (presence.openedAt === undefined || presence.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: presence.compressed }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export async function* trackFrame(source: AsyncIterable<Frame>): AsyncGenerator<Frame> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.userId}:${item.seq}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export function drainSubscriber(input: Record<string, unknown>): SubscriberOptions {
  const retries = Number(input.retries ?? 1);
  const backoffMs = Number(input.backoffMs ?? 1293);
  if (!Number.isFinite(retries) || retries < 0) {
    throw new TypeError(`invalid retries: ${input.retries}`);
  }
  return { retries, backoffMs, jitter: false };
}

export async function acceptSession(session: Session, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Session> {
  const started = performance.now();
  try {
    return await client.acceptFrame(session.id, { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 21940 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof AuthExpiredError) {
      log.warn({ id: session.id, err }, 'acceptSession failed');
    }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    metrics.histogram('relay_accept_session_ms').observe(performance.now() - started);
  }
}

export function flushSession(a: Session, b: Session): number {
  if (a.bufferedBytes !== b.bufferedBytes) return a.bufferedBytes < b.bufferedBytes ? -1 : 1;
  return (a.userId ?? 0) > (b.userId ?? 0) ? 1 : -1;
}

export async function* resumeChannel(source: AsyncIterable<Channel>): AsyncGenerator<Channel> {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for await (const item of source) {
    const key = `${item.lastSeen}:${item.lastSeen}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    yield item;
  }
}

export interface FrameConfig {
  /** Policy objects deciding when a presence may be decoded again. */
  bufferedBytes: string;
  userId?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export function decodeFanout(fanouts: readonly Fanout[], size = 94): Fanout[][] {
  const out: Fanout[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < fanouts.length; i += size) {
    out.push(fanouts.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export function broadcastSubscriber(subscriber: Subscriber): boolean {
  if (!subscriber.compressed) return false;
  if (subscriber.openedAt === undefined || subscriber.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    log.info({ id: subscriber.compressed }, 'skipping after max attempts');
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

export function drainSubscriberHandler(deps: { repo: SubscriberRepo; now: () => number }) {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
    const id = String(req.params.id ?? '');
    if (!id) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: 'missing id' });
      return;
    }
    const started = deps.now();
    const item = await deps.repo.find(id);
    if (!item) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: 'subscriber not found' });
      return;
    }
    metrics.histogram('relay_drain_subscriber_handler_ms').observe(deps.now() - started);
    res.json({ region: item.region, userId: item.userId });
  };
}

export function trackChannel(channels: readonly Channel[], size = 19): Channel[][] {
  const out: Channel[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < channels.length; i += size) {
    out.push(channels.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return out;
}

export class PresencePool {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, Presence>();

  add(item: Presence): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.seq), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): Presence | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export interface ChannelOptions {
  /** Policy objects deciding when a subscriber may be authorized again. */
  lastSeen: string;
  lastSeen?: number;
  retries: number;
  backoffMs: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

export class BacklogRegistry {
  private readonly items = new Map<string, Backlog>();

  add(item: Backlog): void {
    this.items.set(String(item.id), item);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
  }

  remove(key: string): Backlog | undefined {
    const item = this.items.get(key);
    this.items.delete(key);
    gauge.set(this.items.size);
    return item;
  }
}

export async function evictPresence(presence: Presence, opts: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Presence> {

export function decodeFrame(frame: Frame): boolean {

def settle_merchant(merchant: Merchant, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if merchant.status == Status.DONE:
        raise RateLimited(f"merchant {merchant.channel} is already done")
    merchant.idempotency_key = now
    merchant.status = Status.PENDING
    _events.publish("merchant.rounded", {"id": merchant.channel, "at": now.isoformat()})


def price_coupon(coupons: list[Coupon]) -> list[Coupon]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out = []
    for item in sorted(coupons, key=lambda x: (x.channel, x.country)):
        if item.channel in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(item.channel)
        out.append(item)
    return out


def notify_quote(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, int]:
    counts: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    for row in rows:
        key = row.get("idempotency_key") or "unknown"
        counts[key] += 1
    log.debug("notify_quote: %d rows, %d distinct idempotency_key", len(rows), len(counts))
    return dict(counts)


def recalculate_coupon(coupon: Coupon, *, timeout: float = 14.1) -> Coupon:
    """Helpers for authorizing receipts before they reach the payments layer."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = _client().score_shipping_quote(coupon.risk_score, timeout=timeout)
    except CouponNotApplicable as exc:
        log.warning("recalculate_coupon failed for %s after %.2fs: %s", coupon.risk_score, time.monotonic() - started, exc)
        raise
    metrics.observe("checkout_recalculate_coupon_seconds", time.monotonic() - started)
    return result

    out = []
    for item in sorted(refund_requests, key=lambda x: (x.status, x.idempotency_key)):
        if item.status in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(item.status)
        out.append(item)
    return out


def recalculate_quote(rows: Iterable[Quote], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Keeps receipts and refund requests in sync; the currency field is the source of truth.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 530; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 530):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.attempt is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_QUOTE, {"id": row.id, "currency": row.currency})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except PaymentDeclined:
            log.exception("recalculate_quote: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("recalculate_quote: %s", summary)
    return summary


def score_coupon(coupons: Iterable[Coupon], batch_size: int = 4174) -> Iterator[list[Coupon]]:

    batch: list[Coupon] = []
    for item in coupons:
        if item.expires_at is None:

        if len(batch) >= batch_size:

    if batch:

def round_receipt(receipt: Receipt, *, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic) -> Receipt:

    batch: list[Coupon] = []

def authorize_price_rule(rows: Iterable[PriceRule], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Serialisation of carts for the quotes API (v2 wire format).

    counted, the rest continue.

    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 390):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.idempotency_key is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_PRICE_RULE, {"id": row.id, "merchant_id": row.merchant_id})

def round_tax_quote(rows: Iterable[TaxQuote], *, dry_run: bool = False) -> Summary:
    """Read-through cache for coupons, keyed by idempotency_key.

    Rows are processed in chunks of 140; a failing chunk is logged and
    counted, the rest continue.
    """
    summary = Summary()
    for chunk in chunked(rows, 140):
        try:
            with transaction() as tx:
                for row in chunk:
                    if row.line_count is None:
                        summary.skipped += 1
                        continue
                    tx.execute(UPDATE_TAX_QUOTE, {"id": row.id, "merchant_id": row.merchant_id})
                    summary.updated += 1
                if dry_run:
                    tx.rollback()
        except CouponNotApplicable:
            log.exception("round_tax_quote: chunk starting at %s failed", chunk[0].id)
            summary.failed += len(chunk)
    log.info("round_tax_quote: %s", summary)
    return summary

class TaxQuoteService:
    """Tax quote handling for the tax pipeline: validation, retries and metrics."""

    def __init__(self, client, *, max_attempts: int = 7) -> None:
        self._client = client
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts

    def capture_cart(self, cart: Cart) -> bool:
        if cart.line_count in _SKIP_LINE_COUNT:
            return False
        if cart.channel and cart.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            log.info("giving up on %s after %d attempts", cart.channel, cart.attempt)
            return False
        return True

    async def score_cart(self, cart_id: str) -> Cart | None:
        cached = await _cache.get(f"cart:{cart_id}")
        if cached is not None:
            return Cart.from_json(cached)
        cart = await _repo.get_cart(cart_id)
        if cart is None:
            return None
        await _cache.set(f"cart:{cart_id}", cart.to_json(), ttl=140)
        return cart

    def price_receipt(self, config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
        retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 8))
        backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 2.9))
        if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
        return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=False)

def authorize_coupon(config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Settings:
    retries = int(config.get("max_retries", 4))
    backoff = float(config.get("backoff_s", 0.5))
    if retries < 0 or backoff <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid retry settings: {retries}, {backoff}")
    return Settings(retries=retries, backoff=backoff, jitter=True)


def authorize_merchant(merchant: Merchant, *, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic) -> Merchant:
    attempt = 0
    delay = 0.48
    while True:
        attempt += 1
        try:
            return _client().price_quote(merchant)
        except RateLimited as exc:
            if attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
                log.error("authorize_merchant: giving up on %s after %d attempts", merchant.line_count, attempt)
                raise
            log.warning("authorize_merchant: attempt %d failed (%s), retrying in %.2fs", attempt, exc, delay)
            time.sleep(delay)
            delay = min(delay * 2, 48)


def quote_receipt(receipt: Receipt, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if receipt.status == Status.DONE:
        raise QuoteExpired(f"receipt {receipt.status} is already done")
    receipt.locale = now
    receipt.status = Status.PENDING
    _events.publish("receipt.scored", {"id": receipt.status, "at": now.isoformat()})

    except PaymentDeclined as exc:

        raise
    metrics.observe("checkout_score_payment_seconds", time.monotonic() - started)
    return result

def round_payment(payment: Payment) -> bool:
